mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, we have clear skies over Harriet Park with a temperature of 67 degrees. The moon is in a Waning Gibbous phase, and the ISS is set to pass overhead, though cloud cover will hide it from view tonight. Expect a chilly overnight low of 57 degrees with rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona continues to coordinate with AECOM for ongoing engineering services, and residents are invited to provide feedback on the US 18/151 Corridor Study during upcoming public meetings in November.

There is plenty to do around town, including Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory today and Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, also happening today. Tomorrow, you can check out the ART House 360 or play some trivia at Hop Haus.
In the weekly police report from October 25, officers responded to an intersection where they found a man passed out behind the wheel and subsequently arrested him for an O W I.
Our current flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Heath Crunch, but you will need to hurry because we are closing soon at 10 PM.
